centre.name: Irving House Addiction Treatment Centre
centre.about_html:
Irving House Addiction Treatment Centre was founded with the goal of providing high-quality treatment for men struggling with addiction. Currently, the occupancy ranges from 6-15 individuals, with a focus on creating a small, intimate community for recovery. The primary language spoken at the center is English, and the facility currently holds no accreditations.

Who We Treat

The center specializes in treating alcohol addiction, but our services extend to those who are struggling with a wide range of substance abuse issues. This includes benzodiazepines, cocaine, heroin, opioids, marijuana, prescription drugs, and synthetic drugs. We also provide personalized treatment for co-occurring disorders.

Treatment

Our center provides residential treatment for those who require a controlled environment to focus on their recovery. Our philosophy is based on providing evidence-based, experiential, holistic, and non 12-step treatment options to our clients.

Treatment Services

Our treatment services include individualized and group therapies such as cognitive-behavioral therapy, motivational interviewing and enhancement therapy (MET), art therapy, meditation and mindfulness, psychoeducation, recreation therapy, relapse prevention counseling, and family therapy.

Aftercare

Aftercare is an essential component of successful treatment. We offer follow-up sessions online, return visits, and alumni events and get-togethers to help our clients stay on track with their recovery.

Experience

Our center provides air-conditioned private or shared rooms with TVs and internet access. We offer various amenities such as an outdoor lounge, a pool, gourmet dining, a recreation room, and a fitness center. We also provide healthy meals to our clients to ensure their optimal physical health.

Activities

Our center offers a range of activities such as yoga, swimming, games, hiking, and off-site activities. Clients can also attend AA/NA meetings, sightseeing, and access nature through walking trails.

Special Considerations

We cater exclusively to men, providing a safe space for our male clients to heal and recover. Additionally, we provide healthy meals to support physical well-being during treatment.

The facility operates on a fee-for-service basis, giving clients the financial flexibility required to receive treatment without worrying about insurance coverage.

Frequently Asked Questions About Irving House Addiction Treatment Centre

How long does treatment last?

Treatment is tailored to the individual and can last anywhere from a few weeks to a few months.

What insurances do you accept?

We accept most major insurance providers, and our admissions team can help you verify your insurance coverage.

Can family visit during treatment?

Yes, family members can visit during designated visiting hours.

Can I bring my own medications?

We recommend that clients allow our staff to manage their medications during treatment to ensure their safety and optimal recovery.

Is transportation provided to and from the facility?

We do not provide transportation, but our admissions team can provide recommendations for transportation options.

Are there any age requirements for treatment?

Clients must be at least 18 years of age to be admitted into our program.

How often are therapy sessions scheduled?

Therapy sessions are scheduled on an individual basis as part of each client’s personalized treatment plan.

raw_html:
Irving House Addiction Treatment Centre was founded with the goal of providing high-quality treatment for men struggling with addiction. Currently, the occupancy ranges from 6-15 individuals, with a focus on creating a small, intimate community for recovery. The primary language spoken at the center is English, and the facility currently holds no accreditations.

Who We Treat

The center specializes in treating alcohol addiction, but our services extend to those who are struggling with a wide range of substance abuse issues. This includes benzodiazepines, cocaine, heroin, opioids, marijuana, prescription drugs, and synthetic drugs. We also provide personalized treatment for co-occurring disorders.

Treatment

Our center provides residential treatment for those who require a controlled environment to focus on their recovery. Our philosophy is based on providing evidence-based, experiential, holistic, and non 12-step treatment options to our clients.

Treatment Services

Our treatment services include individualized and group therapies such as cognitive-behavioral therapy, motivational interviewing and enhancement therapy (MET), art therapy, meditation and mindfulness, psychoeducation, recreation therapy, relapse prevention counseling, and family therapy.

Aftercare

Aftercare is an essential component of successful treatment. We offer follow-up sessions online, return visits, and alumni events and get-togethers to help our clients stay on track with their recovery.

Experience

Our center provides air-conditioned private or shared rooms with TVs and internet access. We offer various amenities such as an outdoor lounge, a pool, gourmet dining, a recreation room, and a fitness center. We also provide healthy meals to our clients to ensure their optimal physical health.

Activities

Our center offers a range of activities such as yoga, swimming, games, hiking, and off-site activities. Clients can also attend AA/NA meetings, sightseeing, and access nature through walking trails.

Special Considerations

We cater exclusively to men, providing a safe space for our male clients to heal and recover. Additionally, we provide healthy meals to support physical well-being during treatment.

The center offers a wide range of family services, making it an excellent choice for individuals who value openness and communication with their loved ones.
